subject.title: [Feature]: Add a visible browser panel to the Control UI for login handoff and browser management

question: Should the browser login handoff surface ship as a bundled browser-plugin Control UI tab, as a first-party Control UI route, or wait for the broader browser-preview design?
rationale: Current main has generic plugin-tab infrastructure, but automation cannot safely choose the UX, ownership, authorization, redaction, and same-state resume boundary for authenticated browser state.

options.title: Bundled browser plugin tab
options.body: Implement the panel as a browser-plugin-owned Control UI tab descriptor backed by browser.request endpoints and explicit operator scopes.

options.title: First-party Control UI route
options.body: Add a core browser route/page for the handoff flow, accepting tighter coupling in exchange for a controlled first-party UX and security model.

options.title: Defer to preview design
options.body: Keep this canonical issue open but wait for the broader remote browser preview/dashboard direction before building the login-specific surface.

recommendation.title: Bundled browser plugin tab
recommendation.body: Implement the panel as a browser-plugin-owned Control UI tab descriptor backed by browser.request endpoints and explicit operator scopes.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from browser control history and the issue comment that defines this as the canonical handoff tracker.
